question: Should package/update owners accept this opt-in local override replay path plus strict content-inventory requirement for the next release?
rationale: The code review found no concrete defect, but this is a public update CLI and package-integrity boundary where maintainer intent decides the acceptable upgrade and filesystem risk.

options.title: Accept After Owner Review
options.body: Treat the current fail-closed, opt-in replay design and legacy allowlist as the intended package update contract once the draft is ready.

options.title: Require One More Exact-Head Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for a fresh packaged update smoke on the exact head before removing draft status if owners want extra release confidence.

options.title: Pause Or Narrow Replay
options.body: Keep only recovery-bundle preservation and defer automatic replay if owners do not want OpenClaw to mutate local package overrides during update.

recommendation.title: Accept After Owner Review
recommendation.body: Treat the current fail-closed, opt-in replay design and legacy allowlist as the intended package update contract once the draft is ready.
